name: Steel Sky Siege
subtitle: Port Nara, Earth
objective: Defeat all Imperial units. Ace pilot Col. Karg Draven commands the Kargan Rex — bring him down.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: All units, check in. Valstray — green and ready.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Arielis, all systems nominal. I'm picking up six Imperial signatures dead ahead.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Six of them? Ha! Just enough to make it interesting.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Zephyra standing by! Let's send them home in pieces!

lines.speaker: kargan
lines.text: So. The Federation sends its little toys to die in my sky.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Squadron XYZ — weapons free! Mission start!

name: Forest of Rhea
subtitle: Rhea Wilds, Earth
objective: Pursue the retreating Imperial column through the forest and destroy all units.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: They're falling back through the Rhea forest. Don't let them regroup.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: The canopy is thick — my sensors are half blind down there.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Trees, metal, whatever — Grunborg punches through all of it.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Watch the treeline. These Imperial grunts love an ambush.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Move out. Sector Triple-S isn't won yet — this is just the beginning.

name: The Coastal Line
subtitle: Meridian Coast, Earth
objective: Stop the Imperial landing force before it secures the coastal batteries.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Imperial dropships on the horizon — they're making a beachhead.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: They picked the wrong stretch of sand.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Coastal batteries are still ours. Hold them and the fleet can't land.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Form up on me. We push them back into the sea.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Contacts closing fast. Squadron XYZ — engage!

name: Evacuation at Nara City
subtitle: Nara City, Earth
objective: Protect the evacuation convoy — destroy the Imperial raiders in the city.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Civilians are still loading onto the transports. We have to buy them time.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then we don't retreat a single step. XYZ forms a wall.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: A wall? Buddy, I'm a whole fortress.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Imperial raiders entering the city grid from the east!

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: For every home they burn, we answer. Go!

name: The Red Lieutenant
subtitle: Kharon Pass, Earth
objective: Defeat Captain Rax Daver to break the Imperial line.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: A pass this narrow... someone wants us to come through here.

lines.speaker: raxden
lines.text: The XYZ Squadron. The Emperor himself wants your heads — lucky me.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Rax Daver. The Red Lieutenant. You picked a bad hill to die on.

lines.speaker: raxden
lines.text: Big talk from Federation scrap. Come climb, if you dare.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Energy readings spiking — his machine is no ordinary Zolda. Careful!

name: Night Raid on Camp Veks
subtitle: Veks Supply Depot, Earth
objective: Destroy the Imperial supply depot and every unit guarding it.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Fuel, ammo, spare cores — this depot feeds their whole southern front.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Night raid means short sensor range for both sides. Stay close.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: I'll kick their pantry door down myself.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Hit them before they wake up. Burn the depot, break their line.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Contact! They've scrambled the guards — here they come!

name: Hold the Grand Bridge
subtitle: Taranis River, Earth
objective: Defend the Grand Bridge for 8 turns — reinforcements are en route.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Last bridge standing over the Taranis. The whole eastern front is watching us.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Let them come. They'll feed the river one machine at a time.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Charge pattern on their lead unit — it has heavier plating than the rest.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Nobody crosses. Not today, not ever. XYZ — hold the line!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Wave inbound! Battle stations!

name: Airship Docks at Kestrel Bay
subtitle: Kestrel Bay, Earth
objective: Raid Kestrel Bay and destroy the Imperial airship escorts before they lift off.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Those airships are loading siege shells. If they lift off, Nara City is dust.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then they never leave the water. We hit the escorts first.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Eight contacts. Good — I was getting bored.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Dock guns are offline. It's just us and them.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Squadron XYZ — make this bay a graveyard for the Empire!

name: The Counterattack Begins
subtitle: Ash Plains, Earth
objective: Smash the Imperial field army on the Ash Plains — Earth's counterattack starts here.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Today the whole Federation attacks. The Empire learns what Earth remembers.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Their line is stretched thin — we break the center and it all folds.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: I've waited ten chapters for a fight like this!

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: All wings, forward! This is the turn of the tide!

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Squadron XYZ — tip of the spear. Advance!

name: General Moorin's Last Line
subtitle: Imperial Line, Earth
objective: Defeat General Moorin.

lines.speaker: moorin
lines.text: Beyond this ridge lies my Emperor's sky. You will not pass.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: General Moorin — the last real soldier they have left down here.

lines.speaker: moorin
lines.text: Forty years I have served the throne. Come, children — earn your legend.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: An old lion guarding a dying empire. Respect. Now move aside.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Break his line and the path to orbit is open. This is it!

name: Elevator Ascent
subtitle: Orbital Elevator, Earth
objective: Seize the orbital elevator platform and clear Imperial resistance.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Commander — a Crimson frame just broke formation. It's Rax Daver. He's requesting a berth.

lines.speaker: raxdenR
lines.text: I fought you at Kharon Pass and saw what you protect. My blade serves the Ark now — Crimson Fang, reporting for duty.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: The elevator cable reaches all the way to the ring station. Our road to space.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: A fifty-thousand-kilometer elevator. And I thought the bridge was big.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Platform defenders on approach vector — they're not giving it up cheap.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Take the platform. From here on, we bring the fight to the Emperor.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Hold on to your stomachs, everyone. Next stop — the heavens.

name: Debris Field Sigma
subtitle: Earth Orbit
objective: Navigate the wreckage field and destroy the Imperial picket line.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: This debris field is a graveyard of ships from the first invasion.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Wreckage everywhere — perfect ambush cover. Eyes open.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: No ground, no sky, just void. Weird place to die.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then nobody dies. XYZ, spread formation — clear the picket.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: They're here! Between the wrecks!

name: Colony Ring Seven
subtitle: Ring Station, Orbit
objective: Liberate Colony Ring Seven — seize the control beacon behind Imperial lines.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Fifty thousand workers on that ring, all under Imperial guns.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Not for long. They'll be free by nightfall.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Careful with your fire — hull breaches mean civilian casualties.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: We came all this way to free them. Precision over power. Go!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Imperial garrison mobilizing on the ring's surface!

name: Silent Vacuum
subtitle: Deep Orbit
objective: Hold the ambush for 9 turns while the convoy is diverted.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: No sound out here. Even the explosions are silent. Creepy.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: That convoy feeds the throne fortress. Cut it and they starve.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Escorts turning to intercept — they know we're here.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: In the silent dark, we are the loudest thing alive. Engage!

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Heh. Poetic. I like it. Grunborg, moving in!

name: The Void Empress
subtitle: Serka's Domain, Deep Orbit
objective: Defeat Serka, the Void Empress.

lines.speaker: serka
lines.text: Little sparks of Earth. You burn so bravely in my darkness.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Serka. The Void Empress. Half the pilots we've lost fell to her.

lines.speaker: serka
lines.text: Kneel, and I will make your machines into ornaments for my void.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: We've crossed a hundred thousand kilometers, Serka. We don't kneel.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Her frame is radiating power like a small star. XYZ — full power!

name: Moonfall Base
subtitle: Lunar Surface
objective: Destroy Moonfall Base — the Empire's lunar foundry feeding the throne.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: One small step for me, one giant kick in the Empire's face.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Moonfall forges a new Imperial cruiser every month. Burn it.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Low gravity — good for jumps, bad for footing. Adjust your gyros.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: The Emperor's supply chain ends on this rock. Take it apart!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Foundry garrison deploying! Contact, multiple signatures!

name: The Broken Lattice
subtitle: Ring Ruins, Deep Orbit
objective: An Arklander convoy is stranded in the ring ruins — keep it alive for 6 turns while the ambush burns out.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: This was a colony once. Now it's just bones drifting in the dark.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: They're hiding between the ribs of this thing. Clever vermin.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Nine signatures. They want this corridor back badly.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then we take it from them twice. XYZ — through the lattice!

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Ambush pattern confirmed. They come from every angle — hold formation!

name: Voices in the Dark
subtitle: Void Corridor
objective: Rout all hostiles — hunt the Supply Mule before it escapes east

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Their pilots are singing war hymns over open comms. They're scared too.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Good. Fear is the first sound of an empire dying.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Final screen before the fortress. Every push matters now.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: We've buried too many friends to stop here. Weapons free!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: For Earth! For everyone they've taken!

name: Throne Approach
subtitle: Fortress Outskirts
objective: Fight through the outer guard and land any unit on the fortress perimeter marker (crosshair tile) — or destroy every defender.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: There it is. The Steel Throne. A fortress the size of a moon.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: All this way, and I finally get to knock on the Emperor's door.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Outer guard is elite — every one of them is a decorated ace.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: So are we. Squadron XYZ — knock that door down!

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: With pleasure!

name: Serka's True Form
subtitle: Fortress Gate, Deep Orbit
objective: Destroy the Empress Ascendant.

lines.speaker: empress
lines.text: You wounded my pride, little sparks. I have shed my old shell for this moment.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Serka's back — and her frame is twice the machine it was.

lines.speaker: empress
lines.text: Behold the Empress Ascendant! The void itself bows to me.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Gate's behind her — no way through but through her.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Then we go through her. Squadron XYZ, all power forward!

name: Landing at Sol Strait
subtitle: Fortress Dock Ring
objective: Storm the fortress dock ring — seize the landing beacon for the fleet.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: New contact on our six — wait, it's broadcasting Ark codes! The Vexia Custom is ours?!

lines.speaker: vexiaX
lines.text: Lt. Vee Corrin, Ark interceptor wing. I stole this frame back from the dock ring. Let me cover your approach.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: The dock ring's flood barriers work like a strait — one choke point in.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Then it's a storming-the-beach mission. My favorite.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Fleet's holding back until we clear the guns. It's all on us.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Take the strait, raise the banner. XYZ — landfall!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Defense force inbound — they know exactly where we must land!

name: Outer Wall
subtitle: Steel Throne, Wall Level
objective: Hold the breachhead for 9 turns — the fleet needs the wall open.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: A wall of steel a kilometer thick. I've waited my whole life for this crack.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Breach charges are set. When it falls, we're through.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Elite defenders on the parapet — this is the throne's best.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Wall, throne, emperor — one by one they fall. Charge!

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Breach is open! Let's get in there!

name: The Furnace Level
subtitle: Steel Throne, Interior
objective: Fight through the fortress furnace level — the heart of its war machine.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: We're inside it now. This furnace powers every gun on the fortress.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Heat readings are brutal. Don't linger near the vents.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: They built a furnace big enough to fight a war inside it.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then we shut it off. XYZ — into the fire!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Internal guard mobilizing! Here they come!

name: Old Friends
subtitle: Steel Throne, Grand Hall
objective: Karg Draven rebuilt stands between the convoy and the grand hall — keep the Arklander alive for 7 turns.

lines.speaker: kargan
lines.text: The toys of Port Nara, all grown up. I've waited in this hall for you.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Draven. You crawled out of the wreckage just to lose again.

lines.speaker: kargan
lines.text: Lose? I studied you, boy. I rebuilt Kargan around your weakness.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: His frame reads completely different — armor, output, everything upgraded.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then we give him a new lesson. Squadron — engage!

name: Gate Warden Bram
subtitle: Steel Throne, Inner Gate
objective: Defeat Gate Warden Bram. — the Valstray must survive

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: Three hundred years the gate has stood. I am its last warden.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Three hundred years is a long shift. Time to clock out, old man.

lines.speaker: warden
lines.text: The Emperor sits beyond. You will go no further.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: That gate is the last lock on the throne room. One more wall.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: One more wall, Bram. And we are already through it.

name: Inner Sanctum I
subtitle: Steel Throne, Sanctum
objective: Fight through the first wave of the Imperial royal guard. — the Valstray must survive

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: The royal guard — ten of the finest pilots the Empire ever made.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Ten of them, four of us. About fair, I'd say.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Their formation is flawless. Break the pattern, break the guard.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: We've fought for every meter of this war. Take the sanctum!

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Here they come — for the Emperor!

name: Inner Sanctum II
subtitle: Steel Throne, Sanctum
objective: Destroy the second royal guard wave holding the sanctum floor.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Second wave inbound — they're fighting like there's no tomorrow.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: There isn't. Not for them.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: Every step closer to the throne, the resistance gets more desperate.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then desperation is what we give them back. XYZ — forward!

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: For everyone we've lost — finish this wave!

name: Draven's Final Duel
subtitle: Steel Throne, Sanctum Edge
objective: Karg Draven fights his last duel — end it, once and for all. — the Valstray must survive

lines.speaker: kargan
lines.text: One more time, Ardent. Before the Emperor's door — just you and me.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: You keep coming back, Draven. This time, stay down.

lines.speaker: kargan
lines.text: A soldier does not stay down while his Emperor still stands.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: He's buying the Emperor time with his own life. Damn him.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Then we honor him the only way warriors do. All units — attack!

name: The Throne of Steel
subtitle: Steel Throne, Throne Approach
objective: Break the throne approach — land any unit on the gate marker (crosshair tile), or destroy every defender.

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: The throne doors are in sight. Everything we've bled for is beyond them.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: Final defenders — the Empire's last blade between us and Vael.

lines.speaker: gruntborg
lines.text: Then we break the blade and knock on the door.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: For Earth, for the colonies, for every friend we lost — clear the approach!

lines.speaker: zephyra
lines.text: All units — final charge! The throne is ours!

name: Emperor Vael — Final Battle
subtitle: Steel Throne, Throne Room
objective: Defeat Emperor Vael and end the war. — the Valstray must survive

lines.speaker: emperor
lines.text: So the sparks of Earth reach my throne at last. Burn, then. Show me your fire.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Emperor Vael. The war ends in this room.

lines.speaker: emperor
lines.text: I have burned a hundred worlds, boy. Yours is simply next.

lines.speaker: arielis
lines.text: His frame draws power from the whole fortress. This is the last fight.

lines.speaker: valstray
lines.text: Squadron XYZ — for every world he burned, strike him down! FINAL MISSION — GO!
